messages:
Priya: quick OrionPay weekly health — small onboarding tenant. TL;DR: cache hit 22% (-14 pts w/w), avg batch size 1.7 (target 3.0), cost per 1k tokens $3.05 (+40% vs expected), requests +8%
Ethan: Ugh. Are they using our SDK batching or raw HTTP?
Priya: raw HTTP + per-user keys. they haven't adopted SDK batching yet.
Lars: that explains low batch size. traces show very high cardinality cache keys (user-scoped prompt ids).
Priya: sample trace snippet: `cache_key=user:123:prompt:v2:2026-03-15` -> never hits across users.
Ethan: can we do server-side grouping / relaxed keying for onboarding tenants as a stopgap?
Priya: yes — we can flip `batch_grouping: relaxed` for the cohort, but need ops/infra signoff for rollout.
CS-Bot: Alert: OrionPay spend forecast will exceed their planned onboarding budget by ~50% within 72h.
Priya: sharing playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onboarding-orionpay (contains sample SDK patch + rollout checklist)
Lars: proposed immediate steps:
  1) change keying to canonical prompt hash (strip user id)
  2) enable SDK batching or server-side grouping; set `batch_window_ms=25`
  3) enable prefix pref etc for templated prompts
Ethan: quick estimate if we do that: hit rate -> ~50% within 48h, avg batch size -> 2.8, cost/1k -> ~$1.65, latency ~+10ms.
Priya: that reduction should bring spend back in line and reduce renewal risk. scheduling 30m enablement call tomorrow 10:00am PT with OrionPay CS + Eng
Priya: action items: @Ethan take SDK patch & sample repo, @Lars run ops rollback playbook, I'll coordinate customer comms.
Ethan: noted, will open a PR today with `batching: true` sample and include before/after metrics.
Lars: will prepare infra flag and safe rollout window.
Priya: thanks — will post follow-up in this thread after the call with updated metrics: hit_rate, avg_batch_size, cost/1k, p50 latency, error_rate.
